title: unified-rollouts: enhanced canary/A-B/shadow autorollback and telemetry
author: Meera Patel
release_notes: Enhances unified rollouts: composite metric autorollback, staged shadow probing, A/B weighted gating, rollout telemetry (trace ids, event timeline), quarantine stage and cooldowns. Backwards-compatible; adds opt-in rollout config fields.
description: This PR improves the reliability and observability of automatic rollback decisions for unified rollouts (canary, A/B, shadow). Motivation: earlier autorollback decisions were driven by single-metric thresholds and were susceptible to transient noise (request bursts, short-lived infra noise, quality jitter), which caused user-facing regressions and costly rollbacks. Goals: (1) make rollback decisions more robust using composite metrics and quorum logic, (2) provide richer telemetry so operators can audit why a rollback occurred, (3) reduce false positives via staged probing and minimum-sample/cooldown guards, (4) enable safe A/B weight ramp-down and manual override. Changes include: composite metric evaluator (latency P95, error-rate, output-quality regression), metric quorum & weight-based scoring, staged shadow probing window with progressive sampling, quarantine stage before aborting rollout, rollout trace/event IDs emitted to distributed tracing and persisted delta metrics for postmortem, new rollout config fields (compositeThresholds, quorumWindow, quarantineEnabled), and e2e + integration tests. Checklist: - [x] design doc linked (ENG-2211) - [x] unit tests - [x] integration tests - [x] e2e stability runs - [x] docs update (unified-rollouts.md) Related: improves on work from ENG-1040 (old autorollback refactor) and complements telemetry work in OBS-312.

changes_snippet:
@@ rollouts/controller/evaluator.py +12 -6
+def evaluate_composite(metrics, thresholds, quorum):
+    """Compute composite score from multiple signals and apply quorum window."""
+    scores = []
+    if metrics['p95_latency'] > thresholds['p95_latency']:
+        scores.append(1)
+    if metrics['error_rate'] > thresholds['error_rate']:
+        scores.append(1)
+    if metrics.get('quality_regression', 0) > thresholds.get('quality_regression', 0.0):
+        scores.append(1)
+    return sum(scores) >= quorum
@@ rollouts/controller/autorollback.py +45 -8
-    if single_metric_trigger:
-        abort_rollout()
+    if composite_trigger:
+        enter_quarantine_or_abort()

Kai Huang (2026-01-20): Please add telemetry tags for model_version and rollout_id; also the trace IDs need to be propagated to the worker logs for correlation.

Jordan Lee (2026-01-22): Integration tests flake observed on CI due to timing; increase probing window and add retries in test harness. Also suggest adding a safety cooldown of 15m between autorollbacks.

Meera Patel (2026-01-24): Increased probing window in integration tests and added an explicit cooldown config (defaults to 15m). Ran stability job (ci: e2e-stability) and observed no flakes in 5 consecutive runs.
